answer: A new identity leaves a detectable plume of zero-history transactions, and peers raise its interaction cost. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond that decays unless renewed by verified work. The rising tide of bond requirements drowns cheap fake accounts, while every rejected clone sends an echo through reputation graphs, warning validators. Attackers must fund and maintain many bonds simultaneously, making mass identity creation economically ruinous. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
